title: Base change extends a finite-stage tensor comparison to a pushout system
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i_0\le i$, commutative $F(i_0)$-algebras $B_0,C_0$, an algebra map $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$, and commutative rings $P,Q$ with $Q$ a $P$-algebra. Put $B=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$, $B_j=F(j)\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$ and $C_j=F(j)\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$. Give $B,B_i$ $P$-algebra structures, a ring equivalence $e:B\otimes_P Q\simeq C$, and a $P$-algebra map $\mu_B:B_i\to B$ equal to the canonical coprojection. Assume $e\circ\iota_B=\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0$. Let $\mu_C:C_i\to C$ be the canonical coprojection. Give a ring map $\psi:B_i\otimes_P Q\to C_i$ with $\psi\circ\iota_{B_i}=\mathrm{id}_{F(i)}\otimes\varphi_0$ and $\mu_C\circ\psi=e\circ(\mu_B\otimes\mathrm{id}_Q)$. On $J=\{j\in I\mid i\le j\}$ there exist $P$-algebra structures on $B_j$, diagrams $D,E$ of commutative rings in a common universe, a natural transformation $\alpha:D\to E$, ring equivalences $d_j:D(j)\simeq B_j\otimes_P Q$ and $c_j:E(j)\simeq C_j$, colimit cocones $c_D,c_E$, and a bijective ring map $f:c_D.\mathrm{pt}\to c_E.\mathrm{pt}$ with $c_E.\iota_j\circ\alpha_j=f\circ c_D.\iota_j$. For every $j\le k$ the square with horizontal maps $\alpha_j,\alpha_k$ and vertical maps $D(j\le k),E(j\le k)$ is a pushout. Finally $(c_j\circ\alpha_j\circ d_j^{-1})\circ\iota_{B_j}=\mathrm{id}_{F(j)}\otimes\varphi_0$. No finite-presentation assumption is made.

proof.text: Transport P from Bᵢ to each Bⱼ. Let Dⱼ and Eⱼ be ULifts to the common universe of Bⱼ tensor_P Q and Cⱼ, and give them canonical tensor transitions. The compatibility of ψ with its left inclusion makes ψ F(i)-linear. Base change it along F(i) → F(j), using tensor cancellation to identify the result with the indicated source and target.

On the B and Q inclusions, check naturality and left-inclusion compatibility. Tensor cancellation identifies Dₖ with Bₖ tensor_{Bⱼ} Dⱼ and Eₖ with Bₖ tensor_{Bⱼ} Eⱼ. Both maps are base changes of αⱼ, so their transition square is a pushout by the tensor universal property.

The B and C tensor systems have colimits B,C by representatives and eventual equality. Compatible maps out of the D system correspond to compatible maps out of the B system and a map out of Q agreeing on P. Hence its colimit is B tensor_P Q. Construct the cocones with common-universe ULifts. The colimit comparison is conjugate to e: he identifies its restriction to B, and hlim identifies its restriction to Q by evaluation on 1 tensor q. Tensor extensionality proves this identity at the limit. It is therefore bijective.

proof_origin.place: Reviewed repair of the Stacks Tag 02JO (3) construction: he supplies the limit B restriction; hlim evaluated on 1 tensor q supplies the Q restriction. This remains a natural-language proof plan, not a completed Lean proof.

theorem exists_comparison_map_base_change_system
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (e : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (he : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      e.toRingHom.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId ↥(colimit F) ↥(colimit F)) φ₀).toRingHom)
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPi : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (μB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P] (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hμB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
      μB.toRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)
    (ψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ((↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q) →+* (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (hψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ψ.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj i) (F.obj i)) φ₀).toRingHom)
    (hlim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp ψ =
        e.toRingHom.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map μB (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom) :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
      ∃ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        ∃ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y}) (α : D ⟶ E),
          ∃ (d : ∀ j : J,
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∃ (c : ∀ j : J,
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
              ∃ (cD : Cocone D) (cE : Cocone E) (f : cD.pt ⟶ cE.pt),
                ∃ (_hD : IsColimit cD) (_hE : IsColimit cE),
                (∀ j, α.app j ≫ cE.ι.app j = cD.ι.app j ≫ f) ∧
                Function.Bijective f ∧
                (∀ {j k} (r : j ⟶ k), IsPushout (α.app j) (D.map r)
                  (E.map r) (α.app k)) ∧
                (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  ((c j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)).comp
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
                      (A := ↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj j.val) (F.obj j.val))
                      φ₀).toRingHom)
